title: Brawl Stars Totems Pack [by Cuamp]
description: This resource pack adds 5 custom Brawl Stars-themed Totems of Undying that can be selected simply by renaming the totem in an anvil.
body:
# ⭐ Brawl Stars: Totems of Undying

Ever wanted to carry your favorite **Brawl Stars** brawler instead of the regular Totem of Undying?

This resource pack adds **5 custom Brawl Stars-themed Totems of Undying** that can be selected simply by renaming the totem in an anvil. Keep the vanilla feel while bringing a little bit of the Brawl Stars universe into your Minecraft world!

---

## 🎭 Available Totems

Rename your Totem of Undying to one of these names:
* 🖤 **Crow**
* ⚔️ **Kenji**
* 🦎 **Leon**
* 🦇 **Mortis**
* 🌵 **Spike**

Each name unlocks its own unique custom totem.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🎮 5 custom Brawl Stars totems
* 🛠️ Rename the totem in an anvil to change its appearance
* 📦 Lightweight resource pack
* 🌿 Vanilla-friendly
* ⚡ No mods required
* ✅ Made for Minecraft Java Edition **1.21.11**

---

## 📖 How to Use

1. Install the resource pack.
2. Open an anvil.
3. Place a Totem of Undying inside.
4. Rename it to one of the supported names:

   * Crow
   * Kenji
   * Leon
   * Mortis
   * Spike
5. Enjoy your new custom totem!

> **Note:** The names are case-sensitive. Any other name will use the default Totem of Undying texture.

---

If this pack gets enough support, I'll continue updating it by adding **more Brawl Stars characters**!
